image_description: A high-angle, wide shot of an ornate church interior featuring a central altar. The altar is a complex structure with a white marble or stone base, draped with a white cloth, and topped with candles and floral arrangements. Behind the main table stands a large, elaborate altarpiece (reredos) with gold accents, columns, and religious iconography, set within a niche under an arched ceiling. Two tall, narrow windows flank the altar, letting in bright light. The foreground shows a dark wooden railing or communion rail.
